Run command prototypes for clone, setup, initialization, and execution.

# Purpose
This header file declares the interface for the `run` and `run1` command handlers in the application command layer. It includes function prototypes for process setup, configuration checks, workspace and stack initialization, network namespace setup, and the main execution paths for starting Firedancer. The file also declares command permission and argument handling functions, plus the external `action_t` entries `fd_action_run1` and `fd_action_run` used to register these commands.
